title: Landslide Early Warning & Risk Monitoring System — Manual Verification Checklist
instructions: Execute each test in sequence. Fill 'ACTUAL RESULT' and 'PASS/FAIL' for each item.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Start backend (npm start on port 5000) and frontend (npm run dev on port 5173). Open browser at http://localhost:5173.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Application loads cleanly without runtime errors or blank white screen.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Open Auth modal. Test login with citizen, field_team, authority, and admin credentials.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Role badges reflect the logged-in role. Permissions correctly adapt per role.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Navigate to /dashboard. Verify summary cards, alert feed, high-risk table, and quick actions.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Dashboard telemetry renders without NaN or infinite values. Skeletons resolve cleanly.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Click 'Risk Map' in primary navigation.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Leaflet map initializes centered on Northeast India (26.20°N, 92.93°E) at zoom level 6.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: In Risk Map top toolbar, click 'Historical' segmented button.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Historical landslide incidents render as clustered Red (High >=65), Yellow/Amber (Medium 30-64), and Green (Low 10-29) dots based on 10 km density.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: In Risk Map top toolbar, click 'Current' segmented button.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Map switches to active real risk assessments only. If no active events exist, shows honest empty state notice.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Ensure basemap is set to OpenStreetMap Standard (Terrain/Street).
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Street/topographic tiles load cleanly with visible road networks and contours.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Click basemap toggle button (Layers icon in floating controls or header badge).
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Basemap switches to Esri World Imagery with crisp satellite raster imagery.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: 1. Terrain + Historical, 2. Satellite + Historical, 3. Terrain + Current, 4. Satellite + Current.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Markers and overlays render accurately across all 4 modes without flicker, memory leak, or coordinate displacement.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Click any visible historical marker on the map.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Popup opens showing: GSI/NASA Source, Density classification, Local Concentration (e.g. '75 records within 10 km'), State, District, and disclaimer: 'Reflects past documented activity only — NOT a current hazard, prediction, or early warning.'

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Click any active current hazard marker in Current Mode.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Popup displays current risk score, severity level, recorded timestamp, and 'Analyze Area Intelligence' action button.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Type 'Shillong' or 'Gangtok' in the Area Search bar and select an autocomplete result.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Map pans smoothly to selected coordinates, displays blue marker, and opens the slide-over Area Intelligence panel.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Click Zoom In (+), Zoom Out (-), and Recenter buttons on floating map HUD.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Map zooms and recenters without throwing unhandled exceptions.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.test: Verify controls don't change selected location
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Select a location via search or map click. Then click zoom buttons and basemap toggle button.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Selected location and Area Intelligence focus remain strictly pinned; no unintended coordinates are selected.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Switch basemap to Satellite. Zoom in to level 8–10 over Assam/Meghalaya.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Esri World Boundaries and Places reference labels (city names, state boundaries) render clearly ABOVE the satellite imagery tiles.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: In Area Intelligence panel, inspect 'Rainfall & Precipitation' card.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Live rainfall telemetry displays event-day, 24h antecedent, and 3-day multi-scale values in mm.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Inspect weather conditions in Area Intelligence and Dashboard.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Displays temperature, humidity, rainfall forecast trends, and data freshness timestamp.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Trigger area intelligence on high-slope coordinate (e.g. 27.33°N, 88.61°E).
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Fused risk score [0, 100] calculated deterministically with categorical badge (Low, Medium, High, Critical).

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Inspect ML Evidence card in Area Intelligence and direct inference at /api/ml/predict.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Direct ML returns susceptibility and trigger probability. Area Intelligence honestly displays 'Data Limitation' if model artifact is absent in secondary fusion wrapper.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.test: Check alert generation using safe test conditions
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Review early warning alerts generated under simulated high-rainfall test inputs.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Generates appropriate WATCH/WARNING/CRITICAL level with specific actionable trigger reasons.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Click Bell icon in header navigation to open Notification Center.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Slide-out notification tray opens showing recent alerts, unread counts, and severity color accents.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Switch language in header to Hindi (हिन्दी) or Assamese (অসমীয়া). Open Notification Center.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Alert titles, severity badges, and dynamic hazard phrases translate into the chosen language.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Navigate to /field-reports, click 'Submit Citizen Report'. Enter hazard type, description, and coordinates.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Report submits successfully with HTTP 201; returns tracking ID and status 'pending'.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Click 'Use Current Location' button on citizen report form.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Browser prompts for location permission. On approval, populates latitude and longitude fields accurately.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.test: Verify report appears in correct workflow
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Inspect Field Reports table as citizen user.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Submitted report is visible under 'Recent Field Reports' with pending verification status badge.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Log in with role 'field_team' or 'authority'. Open Field Reports page.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Action buttons ('Verify Report', 'Reject', 'Mark Investigating') become visible and active.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Click 'Verify' on a pending citizen report, enter field notes, and submit.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Report status updates to 'verified'. Report is factored into evidence fusion pipeline.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Open Area Intelligence for an arterial hill section (e.g. NH-10 near Teesta / Gangtok).
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Displays operational priority score, connectivity disruption rating, and critical infrastructure assets.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Navigate to /news in primary navigation.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: News feed renders showing regional disaster updates, source tags, disaster category pills, and publication timestamps.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Scan all headlines in News section.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Contains ONLY genuine natural disaster events (landslides, floods, cloudbursts, earthquakes). Zero sports, celebrity, or metaphorical 'landslide victory' political articles.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Search for an invalid coordinate or non-existent settlement (e.g. 'XYZNONEXISTENT999').
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Displays clean 'No results found' without unhandled JavaScript exceptions.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.test: Disconnect network and test offline behavior
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Open Chrome DevTools -> Network -> toggle 'Offline'. Refresh or submit citizen report.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: App shell loads from Service Worker cache. Offline status banner appears. Citizen report is saved to offline localStorage queue.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Toggle DevTools Network back to 'Online'.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Offline banner clears. Queued citizen reports automatically replay and synchronize with backend with duplicate prevention.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Press F5 / hard refresh on /dashboard, /map, /alerts, /field-reports, and /news.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: All routes mount cleanly on direct URL load without 404 or blank screen.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.test: Open in another browser/device if possible
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Open application in Chrome, Firefox, or Edge.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Layout, leaflet maps, and responsive panels render consistently.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: In DevTools, toggle Device Emulation (iPhone / iPad / 375px width).
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Navigation collapses into responsive mobile menu. Risk map and panels adapt smoothly without overflowing viewport.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Open browser Developer Console during all navigation.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Zero uncaught TypeError, ReferenceError, or fatal React component crashes.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.test: Check network tab for failed requests
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Inspect Network tab during normal operation.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: All local API requests return HTTP 200/201. No repeating 500 error loops.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Click search and area intelligence repeatedly.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: In-flight requests are properly deduplicated and debounced; no runaway request loops.

A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.test: Check map performance with large historical dataset
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.steps: Switch to Historical Mode displaying 10,236 records. Pan and zoom across Northeast India.
A_MUST_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: Canvas rendering (preferCanvas: true) maintains smooth 60fps pan/zoom without browser freeze.

B_GOOD_TO_TEST_MANUALLY.expected_result: High-contrast dark mode adapts to light mode with appropriate token contrast.
Selecting 'Floods' or 'Landslides' pill filters news items strictly by disaster category.
Clicking 'Refresh News' triggers cooldown counter (60s) preventing API quota exhaustion.
Pressing Ctrl+K opens quick command palette searching across locations, alerts, and assets.
